description: Taxonomy of dynamic-weight / Balancer-V3-style weight-lifecycle surfaces whose safety depends on the weight-set/update lifecycle invariants (normalized-sum, per-weight bounds, epsilon guard-rail, updateInterval, interpolation-horizon/staleness) being enforced on EVERY permissionless update path. Drives dynamic_weight_lifecycle_audit.py and validate_dynamic_weight_lifecycle_clears.py via dynamic_weight_lifecycle_taxonomy.classify(). RE-SURFACE ONLY: a clear of these surfaces is routed to needs_deep_pass (dynamic_weight_lifecycle_review); it never mints a finding, sets severity, or routes. Motivated by the QuantAMM strict-eval lifecycle MISSES (H-04 stale lastUpdateIntervalTime, M-04 setWeights length-check DoS, M-08 maxTradeSizeRatio bypass, M-09 post-init minWeight bypass, M-12 computeBalance boundary revert, M-14 missing updateInterval) — the weight-set lifecycle family that the math_estimator lens (rule/estimator math) does not cover.
_fp_note: TWO-SIGNAL RULE is the FP backbone: lifecycle_sensitive only when a DOMAIN term (set-weights / weight-update / interpolation / updateInterval / maxTradeSizeRatio / minWeight-maxWeight / computeBalance / normalized-sum / epsilon-guard / lastUpdateIntervalTime) co-occurs with a STRUCTURAL signal (a state-mutating weight setter/update entrypoint, a loop over a weights array, or a per-block interpolation) UNLESS an UNAMBIGUOUS token fires (setWeights, setWeightsManually, _setInitialWeights, _setIntermediateValues, performUpdate, calculateNewWeights, computeBalance, onSwap). Pure getters (view/pure), single +/- arithmetic, plain balance/transfer math, and an admin-ONLY-gated setter with no permissionless update path are NOT tagged (FP control — keeps the bar on permissionless, state-mutating weight lifecycle).
